picked_rationale.CM: CM is the project's flagship mechanistic claim — the residual-stream Location + Causal Intervention strategy is what elevates this work from behavioral replication to mechanistic contribution. The Location sub-arm (probe accuracy 1.00 vs 0.28 null) is strongly supported; the Causal sub-arm is not-supported (flat dose-response within noise). A model-swap variant (same-family Qwen3 sibling) directly stress-tests whether the Location finding holds on a smaller/different-scale model and whether the Causal null is Qwen3-14B-specific, making it the most scientifically informative swap possible under the remaining GPU budget.
